about: Measured Dreamcast recommendations by game and GBFrame device tier. Crazy Taxi has a Vulkan profile for RG Rotate and an OpenGL ES profile for RG DS/RK3568. Sega Rally 2's mid profile is a provisional RG Rotate/T618 measurement: GLES 2x used less GPU than Vulkan while maintaining the same target speed in attract-mode samples. Only measured settings are included; unspecified settings inherit the user's global settings. Saved per-game overrides always take priority.
